pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular polygonal regions with sharp to moderately blunted vertex angles. Patch spatial area decreases significantly along the posterior-ventral gradient of the hindquarter. Edges exhibit high-contrast pixel gradients with jagged linear segments.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous light-toned pathways forming a closed-loop topological graph. Junction nodes are predominantly trivalent (Y-shaped). Pathway thickness is variable, narrowing significantly on the posterior hindquarter where patch density increases.

other_distinctive_markers: The tail is positioned in a distinct dorsal curl, resting against the upper sacral and hindquarter region, revealing the ventral side of the tail base and the distal tassel directed toward the upper right of the frame.
